NDSEP / NGApp.title: NDSEP — National Data Sovereignty Enforcement Platform
NDSEP / NGApp.overview: Nigeria's regulatory-grade platform for data protection compliance, breach management, and sector oversight under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023. Built for the Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC). Includes real-time compliance dashboards cutting across finance, health, and education sectors, plus Healthpoint for healthcare-institution data security using machine learning.
features: Sector oversight with real-time dashboards (finance, health, education)
NDSEP / NGApp.problem: Nigeria's NDPA 2023 created obligations but no unified enforcement tooling — NDSEP gives the regulator a single platform to register, monitor, and enforce data-protection compliance nationwide.

Meridian TaxTech.title: Meridian TaxTech — Nigerian NRS Unified Tax Platform
Meridian TaxTech.arch: Go + Python · monorepo core, microservice planes, signed YAML rule packs, TigerBeetle ledger
Meridian TaxTech.overview: The unified tax platform for Nigeria's Nigeria Revenue Service (NRS): a shared platform core (middleware spine, rule-pack registry, TIN graph, feature store, TigerBeetle ledger services), a compliance plane (e-invoicing T1/T2/T3, POS-VAT T6, WHT T7, TP/CbCR T8, ETR T9, CARF/VASP T10), a sovereign gov enclave (NRS analytics T4, JRB harmonisation T11, institutional case management T13, customs rails T15), and an inclusion plane (informal-sector onboarding T5, presumptive tax T12, taxpayer education T14 with agent app, USSD and white-labeling).
features: Sovereignty boundary — gov enclave deployed separately
Signed versioned rule packs (rp-*) for VAT baskets, presumptive bands, ETR formulas
USSD + agent app for informal-sector inclusion
Meridian TaxTech.problem: Nigerian tax administration is fragmented across legacy systems and excludes the informal economy — Meridian unifies compliance, sovereignty, and inclusion into one platform the NRS can operate.

Blue Economy Platform.title: Blue Economy Platform — Nigerian Maritime PPP
Blue Economy Platform.arch: Go, Python, Rust, TypeScript · Delta Lake lakehouse, TigerBeetle ledger, Mojaloop FSPIOP, Keycloak, Kafka, hybrid Kubernetes GitOps, YOLOX ONNX computer vision
Blue Economy Platform.overview: The Ministry's Unified Blue Economy Platform — a PPP spanning NPA, NIMASA, NIWA, FMMBE and CBN. 24 repositories cover the full stack: governance and ADRs, sovereign vessel tracking (AIS/GT06 ingestion, PostGIS hot path), immutable maritime evidence with transactional outbox, marine insurance (deterministic rating, maker-checker bind/claims), ferry e-ticketing with NIMASA passenger manifests, fisheries traceability with cold-chain IoT, port-call and eCallUp 2.0 truck booking, excise tax stamps, waterway-safety telemetry in Rust, CV vessel detection, a governed lakehouse, and TradeNet-style agency sandboxes (NCS B'Odogwu, CBN TMS, NEPC, NIS, Port Health, NPA e-SEN).
features: Sovereign multi-tier vessel tracking hot path
Deterministic marine insurance engine with VC 2.0 policies
CVFF loan applications via beneficiary portal
FISh/aquaculture traceability from catch to export
Blue Economy Platform.problem: Nigeria's maritime domain runs on paper and siloed agency systems — the platform digitises trade, safety, insurance, and compliance across every agency on one sovereign, auditable foundation.

UmojaFlowOS.title: UmojaFlowOS — Cross-Border B2B Payment Orchestration
UmojaFlowOS.overview: An enterprise control plane for Africa-linked cross-border B2B payment orchestration across Nigeria (NGN), Kenya (KES), and South Africa (ZAR). It coordinates regulated counterparties rather than replacing them.
UmojaFlowOS.problem: Cross-border B2B payments in Africa are slow, opaque, and compliance-heavy — UmojaFlowOS orchestrates the regulated players instead of bypassing them, making corridors reliable.

AgricPlatform.title: AgricPlatform — Nigeria Farmer Platform
AgricPlatform.arch: Next.js role-aware PWA · NestJS services · Angular underpinnings · Open-Meteo API
AgricPlatform.overview: Unified implementation of the Nigeria Farmer Platform PRD v3.3 for NYFN: a role-aware progressive web app for farmers with field data collection and location-based weather forecasting via the open-source Open-Meteo API.
AgricPlatform.problem: Nigerian farmers lack structured digital tooling for data, advisory, and market access — this platform gives extension programs a single role-aware surface.

Nexcomm Exchange.title: Nexcomm — African Agricultural Commodity Exchange
Nexcomm Exchange.arch: React 19 + TypeScript + tRPC + PostgreSQL · 20 microservices · Flutter + React Native mobile · USSD/WhatsApp/Telegram channels
Nexcomm Exchange.overview: A full-stack, production-ready commodity exchange platform for African agricultural markets. A matching engine and settlement engine ensure the accuracy and integrity of the markets shown to users, with WhatsApp, Telegram, and USSD as communication and access channels.
Nexcomm Exchange.problem: African agricultural markets are informal and price-opaque — Nexcomm gives them a real exchange with engineered settlement guarantees and channels farmers actually use.

BIS.title: BIS — Compliance Intelligence Platform
BIS.overview: A production-ready compliance intelligence platform for Nigerian financial institutions and law-enforcement agencies, built for AML/CFT operations.
features: AML/CFT workflows for FIs and law enforcement
BIS.problem: Nigerian institutions must fight financial crime with fragmented tooling — BIS consolidates compliance intelligence into one operational platform.

Unified SOS.title: Unified SOS — Subnational Digital Governance & Revenue
Unified SOS.overview: Nigeria's first unified, multi-tenant digital governance and automated revenue infrastructure for subnational governments — one common operating core, six pilot states, and thirty ranked Technology-PPP opportunities.
features: Multi-tenant state deployments from one core
Unified SOS.problem: Each Nigerian state rebuilds the same digital-governance stack from scratch — Unified SOS lets them share one hardened core and focus on revenue outcomes.

VPP.title: VPP — Open Source Virtual Power Plant Platform
VPP.overview: An open-source virtual power plant platform: it registers distributed energy resources, forecasts and optimizes their dispatch, controls them over the protocols the devices actually speak, and trades the aggregated capacity.
VPP.problem: Distributed energy assets (solar, batteries, EVs) sit idle and uncoordinated — VPP aggregates them into a dispatchable, tradable power plant.

FraudFusion.title: FraudFusion — Multi-Service Fraud Prevention
FraudFusion.arch: Go, Python, Rust, TypeScript, React Native · Prometheus + Alertmanager, signed HMAC release-gate metrics
FraudFusion.overview: A multi-service fraud prevention platform spanning five language stacks, with Prometheus and Alertmanager observability and a signed HMAC release-gate metric producer for trustworthy operational metrics.
FraudFusion.problem: Payment platforms in emerging markets face layered fraud — FraudFusion provides a modular detection stack that scales across services.

HealthLink / datalinkage.title: HealthLink — Healthcare Data Linkage
HealthLink / datalinkage.overview: A runnable, governance-first polyglot reference implementation for healthcare data linkage, extracted from a full architecture, service contracts, and an HCUP NRD pilot specification.
features: Service contracts and pilot specification included
HealthLink / datalinkage.problem: Health records for the same patient live in disconnected systems — HealthLink links them safely under explicit governance rules.

CRUSH (cmscrush).title: CRUSH — Healthcare Fraud, Waste & Abuse Operations
CRUSH (cmscrush).overview: An open-source, Kubernetes-native platform foundation for defensible healthcare fraud, waste, abuse, and coding-integrity operations, implementing a safe executable vertical slice from canonical specifications.
CRUSH (cmscrush).problem: Healthcare fraud investigations fail on defensibility — CRUSH provides an auditable, reproducible operations foundation.

Hydrogen Transport (H2Fleet).title: H2Fleet — Hydrogen Bus Fleet Platform
Hydrogen Transport (H2Fleet).overview: One platform for a city's fleet of 50 hydrogen buses. Instead of building 20 separate apps, H2Fleet implements 20 capability modules in 4 domains on a single platform.
Hydrogen Transport (H2Fleet).problem: Hydrogen transit fleets need refuelling, maintenance, and operations software that vendors sell as 20 disconnected apps — H2Fleet unifies them.

INEC Election Platform.title: INEC — Election Management System
INEC Election Platform.overview: A production-grade, full-stack election management system built for Nigeria's electoral infrastructure; some components are production-ready while others are in progress.
INEC Election Platform.problem: Election administration in Nigeria needs transparent, auditable technology — this system targets that operational core.

MineralVision.title: MineralVision — Mineral Exploration & Compliance
MineralVision.overview: The premiere platform for mineral exploration, discovery, and compliance — unifying the full exploration lifecycle from satellite anomaly detection through compliance.
MineralVision.problem: Mineral exploration is data-rich but tool-poor — MineralVision consolidates discovery signals and compliance into one platform.

NextGen INSR.title: NextGen INSR — Nigerian Insurance Technology Platform
NextGen INSR.overview: A comprehensive, production-grade insurtech platform for the Nigerian market covering the full insurance value chain: policy administration, claims adjudication, agent network management, and KYC/AML compliance.
NextGen INSR.problem: Nigerian insurers run fragmented legacy systems — NextGen INSR provides one modern platform for the entire value chain.

PayGate / PaymentSwitch / CRMaaS.title: Payment Switch Onboarding Platform
PayGate / PaymentSwitch / CRMaaS.arch: TypeScript + Go · onboarding portal for payment networks
PayGate / PaymentSwitch / CRMaaS.overview: A comprehensive onboarding platform for integrating financial institutions, payment service providers, merchants, and businesses into a payment switch network. The portal guides participants through the entire integration process.
PayGate / PaymentSwitch / CRMaaS.problem: Payment switch onboarding is manual and slow — this portal standardises and accelerates participant integration.

RemitFlow.title: RemitFlow — Cross-Border Remittance Platform
RemitFlow.arch: Polyglot microservices + PWA · DigitalOcean Kubernetes, APISIX gateway, Dapr sidecars, Permify authorization
RemitFlow.overview: A polyglot microservices backend for a cross-border remittance and banking platform with a PWA frontend, deployed on DigitalOcean Kubernetes behind an APISIX gateway, with Dapr sidecars and Permify for fine-grained authorization.
RemitFlow.problem: Remittance platforms need cheap, compliant, multi-corridor rails — RemitFlow provides the microservice backbone for that.

TaxStamp.title: TaxStamp — Excise Stamp Issuance & Verification
TaxStamp.overview: Excise tax-stamp issuance, settlement, and field verification: order intake, maker-checker approval, exact-amount payment matching, double-entry posting, resumable serial issuance, and field verification tooling.
TaxStamp.problem: Excise stamp regimes leak revenue to counterfeits and poor accounting — TaxStamp adds cryptographic-grade issuance and verification.

TourismPay.title: TourismPay — Multi-Currency Tourism Payments
TourismPay.arch: Full-stack PWA · multi-currency wallets, QR payments
TourismPay.overview: A full-stack tourism payment PWA for African markets with multi-currency wallets, QR payments, merchant onboarding, and compliance features.
TourismPay.problem: Tourists in African markets face fragmented payments — TourismPay gives merchants one compliant, multi-currency acceptance surface.

Lanai.title: Lanai — Luxury Travel Concierge Platform
Lanai.arch: React + Vite · Twenty CRM backend · Python/Flask AI microservices
Lanai.overview: A full-stack advisor portal and client-facing portal for Lanai Lifestyle, a luxury travel concierge company, with an AI-powered microservice suite on top of Twenty CRM.
Lanai.problem: Luxury concierge businesses juggle clients across chat and spreadsheets — Lanai centralises advisory and client experience with AI assistance.

Agora (OpenDesk).title: Agora — Open-Source AI Receptionist SaaS
Agora (OpenDesk).overview: A fully open-source, multi-tenant AI receptionist / front-desk SaaS: every appointment, call, and front-desk interaction is handled by AI agents with Kafka-driven eventing (internal modules retain the opendesk identifier).
features: AI receptionist across calls and bookings
Agora (OpenDesk).problem: Small businesses lose bookings to missed calls — Agora gives every business an always-on AI front desk.

Singlewindow.title: Singlewindow — Trade Facilitation Portal
Singlewindow.overview: A single-window trade facilitation portal, part of the Newfire platform portfolio (updated recently; active development).
Singlewindow.problem: Traders submit the same data to multiple Nigerian agencies — a single window collapses those touchpoints into one.

Healthpoint.title: Healthpoint — Healthcare Data Security
Healthpoint.overview: A platform for ensuring data security for healthcare institutions, utilizing machine-learning algorithms. Built on a React + Express + tRPC stack with end-to-end typed contracts and wired OAuth.
Healthpoint.problem: Healthcare institutions handle sensitive data with weak security tooling — Healthpoint adds ML-backed protection.

Newfire.title: NewFire — AI Homelab Platform
Newfire.arch: Minisforum X1 Pro 370 control plane + NVIDIA DGX Spark GPU compute
Newfire.overview: A two-machine AI homelab hosting the NewFire AI platform: local LLMs, agent orchestrators, and tenant-aware APIs paired across a control plane and GPU compute node.
Newfire.problem: Owning your AI stack avoids subscription lock-in — NewFire is the reference implementation of that self-hosted infrastructure.

NRS Data Analytics Platform.title: NRS Data Analytics Platform
NRS Data Analytics Platform.arch: Analytics platform for the Nigeria Revenue Service
NRS Data Analytics Platform.overview: Data analytics platform supporting the NRS tax administration analytics workstream (companion to the Meridian TaxTech gov enclave).
NRS Data Analytics Platform.problem: Tax authorities need consolidated analytics to target compliance — this platform delivers that analytical layer.

PoliticalIntelligence.title: PoliticalIntelligence — Political Analytics PWA
PoliticalIntelligence.overview: A political intelligence PWA with generated media assets (auth topology, PWA icons, OG cover via a Pillow asset script).
PoliticalIntelligence.problem: Political campaigns need structured intelligence tooling — this provides a mobile-first analytics surface.

CoreBanking.title: CoreBanking
CoreBanking.overview: Core-banking platform component in the Newfire portfolio.
CoreBanking.problem: Modern banking products need flexible core rails — this explores that layer.

AgentBanking.title: AgentBanking
AgentBanking.overview: Agent-network banking platform component in the Newfire portfolio.
AgentBanking.problem: Agent banking extends financial access to unbanked areas — this supports that agent network.

LandManagement.title: LandManagement
LandManagement.overview: Land management platform component in the Newfire portfolio.
LandManagement.problem: Land administration is paper-bound — this digitises records and transactions.

Realestate.title: Realestate
Realestate.overview: Real-estate platform component in the Newfire portfolio.
Realestate.problem: Real-estate transactions need transparent digital rails.

Nexthub.title: Nexthub
Nexthub.overview: Hub platform component in the Newfire portfolio.
Nexthub.problem: Connective tissue for the platform portfolio's services.

Sonalysis.title: Sonalysis
Sonalysis.overview: Analytics product in the Newfire portfolio.

WhatsAppCommerce.title: WhatsAppCommerce
WhatsAppCommerce.overview: Commerce platform running on WhatsApp as the primary channel.
WhatsAppCommerce.problem: In African markets WhatsApp IS the storefront — this meets commerce where users already are.

DeliveryPlatform (SwitchOS).title: DeliveryPlatform — SwitchOS Multi-Vertical Delivery Commerce
DeliveryPlatform (SwitchOS).arch: TypeScript monorepo (client / server / mobile / services) · Drizzle ORM + PostgreSQL · Vite · pnpm workspaces · Playwright + Vitest
DeliveryPlatform (SwitchOS).overview: An operator-centric, multi-vertical delivery commerce and operations platform. SwitchOS spans merchant operations, consumer ordering, courier and dispatch workflows, payments and payouts, loyalty and campaigns, geospatial routing and growth analytics — a broad commerce-and-operations control plane rather than a single-vertical delivery app.
features: Merchant hub and merchant commerce operations
Courier / driver dispatch and courier radar
Trust, experiments, campaigns and growth analytics
DeliveryPlatform (SwitchOS).problem: Delivery commerce in African markets is fragmented across disconnected merchant, courier and payment tools — SwitchOS gives operators one integrated control plane across multiple verticals.
